caption:
Ever sat in an appointment and blanked on how to describe your pain? It's really common. 📝

A quick five-line note in your phone the day before makes a big difference: where it is and whether it spreads, what it feels like, what makes it better or worse, how it started and changed, and what you'd like to get back to doing.

Words like dull, sharp, burning or tingling are all useful, and there are no wrong answers. Use your own words, even if they sound a bit odd.

Our team at Hybrid Physio will walk you through these questions anyway, but a bit of prep means more time for the useful stuff. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
